description.en-US: Shape of the attribute's values. Only `option` attributes can take part in a variant combination, because a combination is built from discrete Attribute Value records.

Defaults to dynamic, so a new attribute never multiplies a template's variants until a combination is actually used. instant: every valid combination is generated as soon as values are assigned to a template. dynamic: a variant is materialized only when a combination is actually used. never: the attribute carries information but does not take part in the combination key at all.

UI rendering hint. Presentation only; it never affects variant identity. color pairs with each value's color_hex. multi_checkbox lets a buyer pick several values at once, which no single variant can represent, so it is accepted only on a never attribute.
Display order. The combination key sorts by attribute id rather than by this, so reordering never changes variant identity.

Number of templates, archived ones included, that currently apply this attribute through an enabled line. While it is above zero variant_creation_mode is locked: changing it would reinterpret variants those templates already hold. Template lines carry no is_archived, so an archived template still counts.
Number of templates that applied this attribute once and removed it. The disabled line is kept as history, which is why such an attribute cannot be hard-deleted.
Whether variant_creation_mode may still be edited: the attribute is not archived and no template applies it. Says nothing about the caller's permission, which the UI checks separately.
